long_description:
About 

Kirtan is the profound and heart-centered practice of bhakti yoga that utilizes our devotional and emotional nature to draw us inward towards the Reality of our own Heart. Through the enchanting repetition of divine mantras and melodies, boundaries dissolve and a sense of unity with the Divine and fellow participants flourishes. Many are moved to embody the chants through dance and movement, which is welcomed.

Bio

Little Rishikesh Revival is inspired by the sacred spirit of Rishikesh, the revered Yoga Capital of India, home to timeless temples and ashrams and an abundance of unwavering devotion permeating its every corner. Since 2002, following a series of life-changing retreats with beloved teachers Ram Dass & Krishna Das, Tom Fuhrmann & Friends, aka Little Rishikesh Revival, has been leading kirtan in homes, yoga centers, and churches throughout the Denver-Boulder Community as well as in collaboration with many yoga retreats and peace dances.
